reviewer_notes: Paper develops an ENERGY STAR EPI (log-linear panel regression) for integrated steel mills (US+Canada, 14 plants, 106 plant-years). M1 is the fitted regression; M2 records the simple total-energy-per-ton intensity the paper reports and explicitly criticises. Underlying plant data are confidential (non-disclosure), so raw distributions are shown only as kernel density plots. Out-of-sample use is described conceptually but no out-of-sample validation metrics are reported.
